nodes.label: Appraise lifecycle authority
nodes.rationale: Authenticated services own transitions, authorization, evidence review and completion; guidance and launch do not grant authority.

nodes.label: Project capability diagnostic
nodes.rationale: project_diagnostic checks current target identity and the observed MCP/resource contract before Journey work.

nodes.label: One-time handoff redemption
nodes.rationale: Exact Journey, target and ticket are redeemed once; do_not_retry is terminal and connection is distinct from admission.

nodes.label: Authoritative Journey reread
nodes.rationale: Read current Journey and stage-specific operations after handoff, pending events, lost replies and interruptions.

nodes.label: Human review and consent gates
nodes.rationale: Chat approval cannot replace Appraise review, validation, execution consent or closure gates.

nodes.label: Scoped discovery browser receipts
nodes.rationale: Authenticated discovery uses Appraise-owned scoped browser sign-in and exact receipt descriptors; supplemental host observations cannot replace them.

nodes.label: Admitted role assignment
nodes.rationale: Each role uses the current immutable input, scoped assignment, attempt and lease for specialized submission.

nodes.label: Exact lost-reply reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Read durable outcomes before replaying the same idempotent submission; never change keys to escape uncertainty.

nodes.label: Canonical automation preparation
nodes.rationale: Approved scenarios map to canonical operations, ready definitions and locators; preparation does not start execution or grant consent.

nodes.label: Explicit credential rotation
nodes.rationale: Operator reconnect rotates access and requires transport diagnosis and authoritative reread; it does not renew leases, transfer ownership or permit uncertain relaunch.

nodes.label: Generated local AppraiseJS app
nodes.rationale: Authored tests and Quality Journeys persist locally in SQLite; setup upgrades storage without resetting user data.

nodes.label: Guarded application setup
nodes.rationale: Installs dependencies, generates Prisma, applies guarded migrations, seeds canonical definitions and builds the app.

nodes.label: Migration inventory guard
nodes.rationale: Missing or changed files, future history, or ambiguous migration records refuse access; restore matching application files instead of bypassing the guard.

nodes.label: Exact Journey handoff
nodes.rationale: Authenticated ticket redemption binds Journey and target; a launch grants no assignment and expired tickets require a new handoff.

nodes.label: Human Journey decisions
nodes.rationale: Analysis answers, scenario review, consent, remediation, report review and closure remain human decisions in Appraise.

nodes.label: Consent-bound runtime capsule
nodes.rationale: Execution requires consent-bound runtime and sealed evidence; standalone runs and prose cannot satisfy gates.

nodes.label: Pause and owned cleanup
nodes.rationale: Pause fences admission and joins output completion, valid original supervisor stop and browser closure; CANCELLING is not terminal.

nodes.label: Unknown ownership remains blocked
nodes.rationale: Lost ownership and ambiguous effects require investigation; persisted PIDs and empty maps cannot prove cleanup.

nodes.label: Durable outcome reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Lost replies and restarts require reading the same assignment and cycle before retrying an effect.

nodes.label: Explicit access revocation and rotation
nodes.rationale: Disconnect revokes access while preserving data; deliberate reconnect rotates credentials without changing prior approvals or ownership.

nodes.label: Unqualified deployment boundary
nodes.rationale: Operational controls do not attest release qualification, external Codex stop, background wake or host isolation.
